target: projects/q-explorer-mui/ — Q-Explorer React + MUI port (evaluations list + shell)

"Data Quality Index (DQI) DPM" — one acronym expanded in brackets, a second left bare in the same heading
"6 Evaluations" / "4 Evaluations" counts next to each heading, and whether they follow the filters

findings.element: Table row actions — "Done" rows in the Line Analysis DPM and Trip Failures DPM sections, e.g. "Fahrtausfälle DPM – Letzter Monat, BLS, Kanton BE"
findings.finding: 5 of the 19 rows labelled "Done" offer only a red Delete icon and no way to look at the result, and two rows of the same type with the same "Done" chip behave differently — one has the eye icon, the next one down does not — with nothing on screen explaining the difference.
findings.user_impact: I came here to open a finished report; the row says it is Done so I assume the eye icon is missing because the app is broken, and the only button left is the red one I am afraid to press.
findings.suggested_fix: Give every "Done" row an open action, or — where no result exists — replace the chip with a status that says so ("Done — no report available") plus one line of inline text naming why and what to do instead.

evidence.quote: Fahrtausfälle DPM – Letzter Monat, BLS, Kanton BE
evidence.source: plain-language — vocabulary.md "Statuses: only first word capitalized" defines the status wording but nothing on screen reconciles a "Done" status with a row that has no result to open

findings.element: Status column — "Failed" chip on rows such as "Pünktlichkeit – Aktuelles Jahr, BLS"
findings.finding: The 4 failed rows show the bare word "Failed" with no reason and no retry — Delete is the only thing offered — even though the shipped dictionary already contains "Data source was unreachable", "Timed out after 30 minutes", "No data delivered for this period" and "Run again", none of which is ever rendered.
findings.user_impact: I cannot tell whether I asked for something impossible, whether the system broke, or whether re-running would work, so I either delete evidence I may need or leave the row sitting there and stop trusting the numbers on the other rows.
findings.suggested_fix: Render the existing failure reason as inline text under the failed row and add the existing "Run again" action next to Delete.

evidence.source: vocabulary.md > Alerts: "Header: short and easy to understand / Description: adds details to understand the issue" — the status is shown with no description

findings.element: Group accordion headings — "Punctuality DPM", "Raw Data Export DPM", "Line Analysis DPM", "Data Quality Index (DQI) DPM", "Trip Failures DPM"
findings.finding: "DPM" is attached to 5 of the 6 section headings and to most row names, and "TU", "RPV" and "DQI" appear in filters and report copy, with no expansion, tooltip or glossary anywhere on the screen — the app ships the expansions ("DPM — Durchschnittliche Pünktlichkeitsmessung (average punctuality measurement)", "TU — Transportunternehmen (transport company)") but never displays them.
findings.user_impact: I cannot tell whether "Punctuality DPM" and "Trip Failures DPM" are two flavours of one thing or unrelated reports, so I hesitate over which section my evaluation is in and over whether "+ New Evaluation" will ask me something I cannot answer.
findings.suggested_fix: Show the shipped expansion on hover/focus the first time each acronym appears — heading, filter label and report subtitle — so "DPM" reads as "DPM — average punctuality measurement".

evidence.source: plain-language — unexplained jargon; the neighbouring heading "Data Quality Index (DQI) DPM" shows the expansion-in-brackets convention this one breaks

gaps: Live prototype could not be opened from this run (the browser tool returned "Async work scope is closed"), so every quoted string is confirmed against the state map plus the shipped i18n dictionary and app.js render code, not against a rendered screen.

"+ New Evaluation" > Run is in the state map's not_exercised list, so whether the new-evaluation flow ever expands DPM/TU/RPV/DQI, or explains which evaluation type produces an openable report, is unknown.
Report views beyond the first screen were not exercised, so whether a report itself explains its acronyms or its Failed/Done semantics is unknown.

The empty state was only reached by typing a non-matching search term; whether a Status or Period filter that returns 0 rows shows the same "No evaluations found" copy, and whether "Clear filters" is visible beside it in that case, was not recorded.

Delete on an "In Progress" row is recorded as present and confirmable, but the state map does not record whether any copy tells the user the running job is being cancelled, so the reassurance wording on that path is unverified.
